title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards
body:
Searching for % or _ now finds titles that contain them, instead of matching every item.

**Preview:** none — local review only

## What you should know

- **Behaviour change:** in the title search, `%`, `_` and `\` are matched literally. Before, `?q=%` listed every item and `?q=_` any title with a character.
- **Decisions:** bug fix: the failing test is the spec (`test/search.test.js`, "wildcard characters are literal").
- **Changed after the go:** nothing
- **Tests deleted or loosened:** none
- **Manual steps for you:** none

## Evidence

- **Screenshots:** no UI change
- **Reviewer:** pending
- **CI:** not run yet
- **Low findings:** none

<details>
<summary>Engineering details</summary>

The search's `LIKE` now has `ESCAPE '\'`, and `\`, `%` and `_` in the search are escaped before it. The new test failed before the fix (`?q=%` listed all five items).

</details>
